Event

Picking an event fills in the title, message and colours. Every word stays editable.

Ready-made designs

Tap a design to apply its look. Your date, venue, photos and logo stay as they are.

Poster style

Text banner is for padyatra and branch banners: only lines of text, some highlighted in a coloured band.

Banner lines

Each line can be small or big, plain or highlighted. Type in any Indian language (Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali and more) using your phone's keyboard.

Words on the poster

Replace the sample date, time, venue and number with your event's details. Clear a box to hide that line.

Photos

Use the second photo for a visiting Mahatma Ji. Photos stay on this device.

My photo library

Keep Guruji's photos, Mahatma Ji, the ashram building and past events here. Upload once, use on every poster. Tap a photo for options, including removing its background.

Add to poster

Text boxes

For extra lines like a programme list, a special guest, or "भंडारा प्रसाद की व्यवस्था है".

Shapes

Boxes and bands can sit behind the poster text, like a coloured strip behind the title.

Stickers

Elements

Rangoli, mandalas, corners, dividers, ribbons, flowers and more. Tap one to add it, then tap a colour to recolour it.

QR code

Devotees scan it with their phone camera for directions, or to donate by UPI.

Layers

Top of the list sits in front. Tap a name to select it. 🔒 stops it moving by accident; 👁 hides it.

Backup, lock and version

Keep a copy of your work safe, and protect the official name and logo.

Backup

Your posters are stored only in this phone's browser. Download a backup now and then, and keep it in Google Drive or send it to yourself on WhatsApp. If you change phones or clear the browser, restore it here.
